# sonarqube_qualitygate_project_association (Resource)

Assigns a quality gate to a project. Changing the gate reassigns it in place. Import ID: `gatename/projectkey`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sonarqube_qualitygate" "strict" {
  name = "Strict"

  condition {
    metric    = "new_coverage"
    op        = "LT"
    threshold = "80"
  }
}

resource "sonarqube_qualitygate_project_association" "api" {
  gatename   = sonarqube_qualitygate.strict.name
  projectkey = "example-api"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gatename` (String) Gate name.
- `projectkey` (String) Project key.

### Optional

- `gateid` (String, Deprecated) Ignored.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_qualitygate_project_association.example 'Strict/example-api'
```
